newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to send aid to refugees in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to send aid to refugees in Zaire.

text.p: Portugal will pay for a team of doctors and nurses to distribute 10 tonnes of food and drug supplies to refugees fleeing ethnic conflict in eastern Zaire, a foreign ministry spokeswoman said on Thursday.

"A preliminary mission of the Portuguese International Medical Assistance (AMI) group, paid for by the government, leaves for Zaire by tomorrow to look into how the aid will be distributed," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said Portugal was still studying a proposal by France and Spain to send a multi-national force to ensure aid gets through to the thousands of refugees in eastern Zaire.
"We are seeking more information about this proposed multi-national force," she said.
At a meeting in Madrid on Wednesday France and Spain suggested sending 5,000 troops to open humanitarian routes to help the refugees, some of whom are already dying of thirst and starvation.
